sections.heading: How To Use?
sections.text:
Apply evenly on clean, dry lips.
Swipe gently across the lips until a smooth layer is formed.
Use before stepping out in the sun to support daily lip protection.
Reapply as desired, especially after eating, drinking, or wiping your lips.
Use daily to keep lips soft, nourished, and protected from dryness.
For external use only. Do not apply on damaged, irritated, or cracked skin. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Mango Mint Flavored Lip Balm SPF 50

Sun Protection | Fresh Lips | Mango Mint Care

Get ready to swipe on freshness with the Mango Mint Lip Balm SPF 50 — a nourishing lip balm made to protect, moisturise, and care for dry, chapped, and sun-exposed lips.

This daily-use lip balm comes with SPF 50 sun protection, helping shield your lips from harsh sun exposure, tanning, dryness, and further darkening caused by UV rays. Its smooth balm texture glides easily on the lips and leaves them feeling soft, comfortable, and nourished.

Packed with moisturising ingredients like Coconut Oil, Shea Butter, Almond Oil, Avocado Oil, Jojoba Oil, Castor Seed Oil, Squalane, and Beeswax, it helps support lip hydration, smoothness, and a healthy-looking finish.

The refreshing Mango Mint flavour gives every application a fruity, cool, and fresh feel — perfect for daily use, college, office, travel, outdoor days, and regular lip care.

A fresh, protective, and nourishing lip balm made for soft lips, SPF care, and everyday confidence.

Note: For external use only. Apply evenly on clean, dry lips and reapply as desired. Avoid using on damaged or irritated lips. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. What is this lip balm used for?

This lip balm is used to moisturise, nourish, and protect the lips from dryness, chapping, and sun exposure.

Q2. Does this lip balm have SPF?

Yes, it helps provide SPF protection to support daily lip care during sun exposure.

Q3. Can I use it daily?

Yes, it is suitable for everyday use and can be applied multiple times as needed.

Q4. Can it help with dry and chapped lips?

Yes, it helps keep lips soft, smooth, and moisturised while reducing dryness and rough feel.

Q5. When should I apply it?

Apply it on clean, dry lips before going outdoors, during the day, or whenever your lips feel dry.

Q6. Can I use it under lipstick?

Yes, you can apply a light layer before lipstick to keep lips comfortable and moisturised.

Q7. Is it suitable for travel?

Yes, its compact size makes it easy to carry in your bag, pocket, purse, or travel pouch.
